race.comment: Tough task for punters to start the day with all but one of these on debut. Ciaron Maher's Bivouac filly ROSARITO (13) makes the most appeal following a trial win at Warwick Farm recently. Half-sister to the three-times stakes placegetter Ojai. Looks a ready-to-run type. ROYAL ACCORD (6) will offer a serious challenge for Team Hawkes. By Home Affairs from a Lonhro mare. Has trialled twice and won them both so he is hard to fault. TUNGTUNGTUNG SAHUR (9) did enough in his only trial to suggest he is ready to run well while JENNI IN ROME (12) bolted up in her first trial. Quieter in her second but she is one to go well.
